plurals.name: diff_years

Text indicating that the event occurred two or more years ago."%d" is the number of years.

plurals.name: edit_diff_bytes
plurals.item: Text for the revisions difference in bytes. %s will be replaced by the positive one or negative one.
Text for the revisions difference in bytes. %s will be replaced by the number of bytes.

plurals.name: edits_since_year_per_wiki
plurals.item: Text showing the total number of edits made by a user since a specified year on a specified wiki. Format: ''translated text for a singular number of edits''. Within each ''translated text'': * %1$d is replaced by the total edit count (its displayed value also conditions which plural form to be used to select the appropriate ''translated text''); when translating to languages that use a singular form for different numbers (e.g. 21, 31... in Slavic languages, not just 1), you '''must''' use that symbol inside the translated text to show the actual number! * %2$s is replaced by the year that the user account was created. * %3$s is replaced by the language of the given wiki.

Text showing the total number of edits made by a user since a specified year on a specified wiki. Format: ''translated text for a plural number edits''. Within each ''translated text'': * %1$d is replaced by the total edit count (its displayed value also conditions which plural form to be used to select the appropriate ''translated text''); when translating to languages that use a singular form for different numbers (e.g. 21, 31... in Slavic languages, not just 1), you '''must''' use that symbol inside the translated text to show the actual number! * %2$s is replaced by the year that the user account was created. * %3$s is replaced by the language of the given wiki.

plurals.name: format_reading_list_statistical_detail
plurals.item: Detailed description shown for a reading list that contains one article; The %1$d parameter is the number pages saved to disk for offline reading (zero or one), and the %3$.2f parameter is the number of megabytes saved to disk for this list.

Detailed description shown for a reading list that contains multiple articles; The %1$d parameter is the number of pages saved to disk for offline reading, the %2$d parameter is the number of total pages in the list, and the %3$.2f parameter is the total number of megabytes saved to disk for this list.

plurals.name: format_reading_list_statistical_detail_without_size

Detailed description shown for a reading list that contains multiple articles; The %1$d parameter is the number of pages saved to disk for offline reading, the %2$d parameter is the number of total pages in the list.

plurals.name: format_reading_list_statistical_summary
plurals.item: Summary shown for a reading list that contains one article. The %2$.2f parameter is replaced with the cache size of the article.

Summary shown for a reading list that contains multiple articles; The %1$d parameter is the number of pages in the list, and the %2$.2f parameter is the total number of megabytes saved to disk for offline page reading.

plurals.name: format_reading_list_statistical_summary_without_size
plurals.item: Summary shown for a reading list that contains one article which is not downloaded, and hence not taking up disk space.
Summary shown for a reading list that contains multiple articles; The %d parameter is the number of pages in the list which are not downloaded, and hence not taking up disk space.
